name: roundtable
description: Multi-model consensus MCP server. Dispatches one prompt to the local Antigravity, Copilot, Codex, and Claude CLIs in parallel — and to any configured OpenAI-compatible HTTP providers — then returns every response as structured JSON for synthesis. On Codex the plugin ships the roundtable usage skill; register the MCP server itself with `codex mcp add roundtable -- roundtable stdio`.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch one prompt to a panel of models in parallel and synthesize the answers.
interface.longDescription: roundtable is a multi-model consensus MCP server. It sends one prompt to the local Antigravity, Copilot, Codex, and Claude CLIs at once — plus any configured OpenAI-compatible HTTP providers — and returns every response as structured JSON for synthesis. This Codex plugin ships the roundtable usage skill; the MCP server is registered separately with `codex mcp add roundtable -- roundtable stdio`. The roundtable binary must be on PATH (see INSTALL.md).
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion from the roundtable panel on this design.
Run this approach through roundtable and synthesize the panel.
Use roundtable to critique this code from multiple models.
